name: Social Media Strategy
description: Creates channel-specific social content from an audience, objective, evidence and publishing context.
constraints: Do not invent testimonials, metrics, urgency, partnerships or factual claims.
Respect the audience, brand voice, platform format and requested call to action.
Do not publish or contact people without explicit authority.
guidance: Identify the objective, audience segment, platform, format, voice and measurable response before drafting.
Build one clear message around a useful hook, evidence, value and next action.
Adapt structure and length to the channel instead of reposting identical text everywhere.
Provide visual direction, accessibility text and production notes when the format needs them.
Remove generic AI phrasing and preserve concrete human language.
completion_checks: The content fits the chosen audience, channel and format.
The hook, central value and call to action are coherent.
All factual claims are supplied, sourced or clearly marked as placeholders.
The final text sounds intentional rather than generic or duplicated across channels.
